# Station Echo

## The Watch

Captain Vess commands the Echo Station. Captain Vess keeps the Resonance Key in the Docking Bay. Engineer Mira watches the Data Core. Engineer Mira guards the Observation Deck.

## The Docking Bay

The Docking Key is hidden in the Greenhouse. The Docking Key is stored in the Greenhouse. The Greenhouse orbits beyond the Observation Deck. The Beacon Core hums at the center of the Echo Station. The Beacon Core glows.
